title: Component
description: An entry in a system's map: a Component, Resource, AiResource (a skill or hook), API, System, Domain or Group, as its kind says, in Backstage's entity model. Workbench holds the map; catalog-info.yaml is its export (scripts/map.sh export), and the first import on a new machine (MAP.md).

kind.description: Backstage kind: Component, Resource, AiResource, System, API

type.description: spec.type: service, library, website, skill, hook, database, ...

lifecycle.description: spec.lifecycle: production, experimental, option, listed, deprecated

system.description: spec.system: the system it belongs to (core, options, sources, or another system's)

domain.description: spec.domain (a System's): the domain it belongs to, e.g. substrate

subcomponent_of.description: spec.subcomponentOf: the component it is part of

depends_on.description: spec.dependsOn: entity refs it needs (component:x, resource:y)

provides_apis.description: spec.providesApis: the APIs it provides (its slots)

definition.description: spec.definition (an API's): what the interface is
